title: One forge module answers merge request and pipeline state for land, merge, red-pipeline and stalled, with a glab arm and a gh arm
goal: _tools/bl_forge.py is the one place that reads a forge: merge request state by title prefix or branch (merged, opened with its pipeline status and detailed merge status, closed), the newest pipeline of a ref, and merge of the item's own request (the glab arm only: the gh arm reads state and its merge refuses); land, merge, red-pipeline, selfcheck's main check and stalled call it and nothing else runs glab; backlog.json names the forge (gitlab with glab, github with gh) and the project, and with forge_project set every forge call of land, merge, red-pipeline and ql_deliver uses that one project (ql_deliver.forge_list re-derived it from the URL while the request read and the description PUT used the setting, so a wrong request's description could be overwritten; bl_intake and ql_deliver ignored the setting); a read happens once per land pass, and land --wait-merge sleeps and re-reads at its long interval, never a loop a session writes; stalled gains mr-dead (pipeline failed, canceled, skipped or manual, or merge blocked: none of these becomes merged by waiting). The gh arm is tested on recorded fixtures only.

run: import sys; sys.exit(1 if any('"glab"' in open('_tools/' + f, encoding='utf-8').read() for f in ('bl_land.py', 'bl_intake.py', 'bl_ci.py', 'bl_stall.py', 'bl_selfcheck.py', 'ql_deliver.py')) else 0)

links: memory: GitHub is the kb's public home, gitlab.com the private dev and CI; a gh arm serves the publish side later
notes: Merged from BG-iq52pvdl “forge_project is half-honoured: land lists merge requests by the remote URL's project but reads and rewrites descriptions by the setting's” at the 2026-10-10 backlog triage (its goal is folded into this goal; found by the SP-befc6yqr review, S2 of ST-qgnjxiol). Premise: bl_land.py:814 and :2035 read forge_project, ql_deliver.forge_list:77 re-derives the project from the URL, and bl_intake.py has no forge_project; the single forge module removes the split by construction. Premise run at planning (SP-dqkf3i42, 2026-10-10): python3 -c "import sys; sys.exit('forge_project' not in open('_tools/bl_intake.py').read())" exits 1 on the base, so it reproduces; _tools/bl_forge.py is absent. selfcheck's main check reads ci.pipeline ops rows and makes no forge call itself, so the story names it only as a reader of the rows red-pipeline writes. Its tests go in the new _tools/test_forge.py (the first task creates it; git add it before a test run). The -k selectors collect NONE on the base: tests yet to write.
